basic_info.description:
Discover this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home nestled in the vibrant city of San Francisco. With 1,492 sq ft of inviting living space, this residence offers a perfect blend of comfort and convenience. The heart of the home is its spacious kitchen, ideal for culinary enthusiasts and gatherings. Enjoy meals in the formal dining room or unwind in the separate family room, offering ample space for relaxation and entertainment.

The home features a cozy fireplace, adding warmth and ambiance to your living experience. The practical layout includes in-garage laundry, ensuring convenience for your daily routines. 

Additionally, the property boasts two garage spaces, providing secure parking and storage solutions. Located within the San Francisco Unified School District. Embrace the opportunity to reside in one of San Francisco's sought-after neighborhoods with this delightful property.
